Fej1pY6Air.name: Zombie Shop
Fej1pY6Air.description: You can get 50 Brains when a plant dies, and all zombie players get 125 Brains when a flag starts. You also gain 2 brains every second. Instant kill zombies, such as Zomboni and Gargantuars, and bosses cannot get close to the plant's door. Any other zombie can attack the door, so get to work!

TZvkeuhzqh.name: AI Plant Shop
TZvkeuhzqh.description: AI Plants can be spawned at any time, and the number of plants you can spawn is located in the bottom right corner. When a plant you spawned dies, you will be able to respawn one again. When a Plant AI that you spawned kills a zombie, you will get the sun. AI Plants are not free! They will still take away the amount of sun and coins noted in the requirements.
